title: Engineering Manager, Financial Services
description:
**About Tide**
 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
   

  

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
   

  

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
   

  

**Tide Facts**
* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg


**About The Role**
 As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you’re an experienced Full Stack Engineering Leader with strong people\-management skills, comfortable operating at scale and driving impact through well\-designed platforms.
   

  

 In this critical role, you will lead a cross\-functional engineering team (comprising Backend, Mobile, and Web engineers) and partner closely with Product Management to own and lead our global In\-Person Acquiring products.
   

  

 In\-Person payments currently account for a significant majority (65%\+) of our Acquiring revenue in key markets, making this a highly visible, high\-impact domain. You will own the technical direction and end\-to\-end execution of systems that power our in\-house ePOS solutions, Tap to Pay technologies, cross\-platform mobile apps, and complex pricing engines. You will oversee the maintenance of highly reliable live products while leading the architectural strategy for critical third\-party vendor integrations and hardware partnerships. Additionally, you will drive major platform transformation initiatives and lead the engineering scaling of localized payment networks (such as QR/UPI) across international markets, alongside rollout toolkits for our European expansion.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
* Full Stack Leadership: Proven track record directly managing, coaching, and developing cross\-functional teams of Backend, Mobile, and Web engineers.
* Technical Depth \& T\-Shaped Leadership: A platform\- and tech stack\-agnostic engineering leader who is an expert in at least one core domain/platform (e.g., backend or mobile), with the proven ability to translate those core software engineering principles to guide, mentor, and architect solutions across other platforms in a T\-shaped leadership model. Extensive experience building robust applications, server\-side engineering, mobile app deployment architecture, and scalable system design.
* Domain Expertise: Experience in FinTech, specifically within Acquiring, In\-Person Payments, ePOS systems, or payment gateway integrations is highly desirable.
* Architecture \& Scale: Experience engineering scalable, reliable solutions in a cloud\-native environment, managing microservices, and implementing RESTful APIs and event\-driven systems.
* Partner Integrations: Proven experience designing systems that seamlessly integrate with complex third\-party vendors, hardware providers, and external payment networks.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Full ownership of technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, championing engineering best practices from development and testing to production deployment and monitoring.
* Strategic Execution: A technical, hands\-on leader who can guide architecture decisions, translate complex product strategy into reliable platform solutions, and communicate technical concepts seamlessly to stakeholders.


**Our Tech Stack**
* Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
* Event\-driven architecture with messages over SNS\+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
* Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
* Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
* DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
* GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines \- new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
* Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
* Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust \+ some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management


**What You’ll Get In Return**
* Competitive Compensation \- competitive salary and share options
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top\-up options.
* Life \& Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering \& Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning \& Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks \& Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).


**Tidean Ways of Working**
 At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team.
   

  

 TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
   

  

 At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently\-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
   

  

 We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
   

  

*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*
**Disclaimer**

* Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

* Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
   

  

 Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*

 ta@matrixst.in

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Location**
 HYDERABAD OFFICE INDIA PSC PGH
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Family Summary:
   

  

 P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.
   

  

**Dedication from Us:** 
 You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.
   

  

**What we Offer:** 
 Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the center, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.
   

  

 The Data Architecture job family involves leading the data design for an application, solution, or business domain, helping to define how data will flow, and be stored and structured.
   

  

 We are looking for an Architect to join our Supply Chain Innovation organization and lead the design of enterprise\-scale Generative AI solutions that run on top of P\&G's data platform. At P\&G, AI is not a standalone experiment — it is an operational interface over the data that runs our business, from supply chain and vendor systems to retail distribution and consumer insights. In this role you will own the architecture for how our AI systems retrieve, reason over, and act on enterprise data, working hands\-on while setting the standards other engineering teams build against. This is an exciting opportunity for a self\-motivated architect who enjoys solving complex technical problems and delivering high\-impact global solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise GenAI solutions — retrieval, orchestration, integration, and evaluation — ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned to business outcomes.
* Design production retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures over enterprise data, including document ingestion and chunking, indexing strategy, hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Architect multi\-phase agent and tool\-calling workflows with deterministic guardrails — scoped tool access, structured output schemas, validation, bounded retries, explicit completion contracts, and fallback handling — so that non\-deterministic models meet production reliability standards.
* Design the data ingestion and synchronization foundations that support AI grounding — streaming and change data capture from enterprise sources, canonical data models, and incremental sync that keeps indexes and downstream systems current.
* Enforce data governance and strict multi\-tenant isolation boundaries across brands, regions, and partners, applying access control, PII protection, and Responsible AI principles by default.
* Establish evaluation and observability standards for AI workloads — curated test sets, automated quality scoring including model\-based judging, regression suites in CI/CD, and end\-to\-end tracing of model behavior in production.
* Own the operational economics of AI systems: latency and throughput targets, inference and token cost management, caching strategies, and routing work to the appropriate model for the task.
* Act as the principal technical authority for AI architecture — lead design reviews, resolve complex performance and integration issues, mentor engineers, and champion Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.


 Ideal Candidate:
   

  

* A hands\-on architect who can independently design end\-to\-end solutions while remaining active in development, code review, and production problem\-solving.
* Treats AI systems as distributed data systems — designs for failure, latency, duplication, and drift rather than assuming the happy path.
* Collaborative and self\-motivated, able to work across global teams, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.


**About Us**
 We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
   

  

 Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor
   

  

**Job Qualifications**
 Job Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on architecture and technical leadership of large\-scale, multi\-tenant, or high\-throughput platforms.
* Hands\-on experience designing and delivering production Generative AI solutions — retrieval\-augmented generation, LLM\-based classification and extraction, or multi\-phase agent workflows — including the schema validation, guardrails, and fallback logic that make them dependable.
* Proven experience architecting orchestration layers for distributed systems — event\-driven and streaming pipelines, workflow and state management, idempotency, bounded retries, and recovery from partial failure — and applying the same discipline to AI and agent workflows.
* Strong grounding in search and retrieval: inverted indexes and lexical relevance scoring, vector and semantic similarity, hybrid retrieval and rank fusion, re\-ranking, and the effect of data freshness on retrieval quality.
* Experience defining quality and evaluation practices for probabilistic systems — curated test sets, regression suites, automated and model\-based scoring of output quality, and production tracing.
* Experience integrating heterogeneous enterprise systems and data sources at scale across streaming, API, and file\-based patterns, with strong data modeling and schema governance instincts.
* programming skills in at least one backend language (Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or similar), with hands\-on experience across document and relational data stores.
* Cloud\-native engineering experience (Azure) with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability as default practice.
* Ability to lead technical design discussions, drive solution decisions, and operate as a hands\-on technical lead within cross\-functional and global teams.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


 Preferred: Working knowledge of modern lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and medallion data architectures; familiarity with AI governance, guardrails, and evaluation tooling; experience integrating enterprise systems; experience designing for regulated or highly sensitive data environments.
   

  

**Job Schedule**
 Full time
   

  

**Job Number**
 R000159260
   

  

**Job Segmentation**
 Experienced Professionals

title: Software Development Manager, FinTech General Ledger
description:
**Description**
 We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems — the mission\-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi\-year financial transformation: re\-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond.
   

  

 You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle — spanning sub\-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration — delivering high\-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale.
   

  

 This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re\-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end — close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target\-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in large\-scale distributed systems, preferably a background in financial or ERP systems, and a proven ability to lead teams through ambiguous, high\-stakes transformation while keeping production healthy. You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long\-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation\-first solutions.
   

  

 If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger — modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self\-healing future state — we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead architecture, design, and delivery of GL and close systems, making technical decisions that balance near\-term reliability with the long\-term target state
* Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for your team, working backwards from FGBS customer needs and the broader GL modernization program
* Guide your team through system and process transformation — sequencing migration, modernization, and automation work while protecting the integrity and timeliness of every close
* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of software engineers, fostering a culture of automation\-first thinking and technical excellence
* Own operational metrics and system health for GL and close systems, establishing mechanisms to monitor progress and drive continuous improvement
* Partner with finance, controllership, and product teams to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, creating clear career paths and coaching that helps your team grow
* Champion automation and rapid iteration, continuously eliminating manual touchpoints to shorten Amazon's financial close timeline


**About The Team**
 We are the engineering organization behind Amazon's General Ledger and month\-end close — one of the most complex and high\-stakes financial processes in the company. Our teams own the timely and accurate closure of sub\-ledgers and the General Ledger, ensuring that approximately 900 million transactions per month are accounted for with precision, along with the foundational GL functions — ledger setups, posting and recurring schedules, journal processing, and close orchestration — that keep Amazon's financial engine running.
   

  

 What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization. We are actively building the next generation of Amazon's General Ledger and redesigning the close processes around it, with the goal of a faster, more resilient, and ultimately touchless close. Every sprint moves us closer to that future state — and this role helps lead the way there.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

**Position Summary:** 
 AI Solutions Architect (Senior Consultants, Managers)
   

  

****Role Summary****
 We are seeking an AI Solutions Architect to design and deliver production\-grade AI agent platforms. The core of this role is building multi\-agent orchestration systems using LangGraph and Anthropic Claude—routing user intent to specialized sub\-agents, implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over policy documents, and performing actions. You will own the architecture from LLM prompt design to multi\-tenancy and vendor integration across HR platforms (Workday, SAP, Oracle HCM). You will collaborate with engineering, security, and product teams to translate business requirements into production\-ready AI agent solutions.

* Senior Consultant: 6\+ years total experience, with significant time in AI/ML solution design
* Manager: 10\+ years total experience, with significant time in AI/ML solution design

* Design and implement multi\-agent orchestration using LangGraph—intent classification, sub\-agent routing, state management, checkpointing, and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) interrupt flows.
* Architect RAG pipelines: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, vector search (pgvector), hybrid retrieval, and citation\-grounded response synthesis.
* Evaluate and integrate LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, etc.), defining model selection strategies, prompt engineering standards, and token budget management across agent tiers and multi\-tenant data layers
* Design vendor integration patterns using direct APIs, MCP, and A2A protocol for complex HR platform workflows.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures from user interaction through agent orchestration, vendor API integration, and production deployment with monitoring.

* , partner with the Data Integration Architect who owns document ingestion and vector store architecture; own downstream AI application concerns (retrieval strategy, prompt design, response synthesis, evaluation).
* Conduct architecture reviews and mentor teams on best practices in LLM application design, agent patterns, and production readiness.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture decisions and delivery roadmaps; produce HLD/LLD and ADRs.

* Strong understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation

* Expert\-level Python development for production systems
* Strong hands\-on experience building API services with FastAPI
* Working knowledge of multi\-tenant security patterns
* (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent) for architecture work, design documentation, and engineering workflows. Familiarity with agentic engineering patterns is expected.
* Strong communication and documentation skills; ability to influence cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocol for vendor and cross\-system integrations.
* Experience integrating with HR/HCM platforms
* Experience with LangFuse, LangSmith, or similar LLM observability and tracing platforms.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices: PII handling, prompt injection defense, model risk management, and explainability.
* — working familiarity with cloud\-native deployment (Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, observability), data engineering patterns (ETL/ELT, lakehouse, streaming), and the operational implications for AI platforms. Not expected to own these, but must collaborate effectively with Cloud Solution and Data Integration architects in joint reviews.

* Architecture leadership with pragmatic trade\-off decisions (speed vs. risk, cost vs. accuracy, build vs. buy, direct integration vs. protocol abstraction).

 Solution Architect owns the solution strategy, functional design and client relationship — ensuring the migrated platform delivers the business outcomes the client's marketing operations, CRM and digital teams need, while the Technical Architect delivers the technical implementation. * Author the migration approach document — defining the phased migration strategy, wave sequencing, subscriber migration methodology, journey migration priority framework, legacy platform deprecation schedule and business cutover approach with go/no\-go criteria.
* Design the subscriber data migration strategy — at the functional level: defining which subscriber segments migrate, the business rules governing data transformation, suppression list governance, consent record mapping requirements and the subscriber validation criteria the business will use to sign off each data wave.
* Own the consent and compliance architecture — mapping legacy consent records, preference data and suppression lists to Marketing Cloud Next consent model and Data Cloud consent API, ensuring GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI obligations are met in the migrated platform from day one.
* Design the journey migration blueprint — inventorying and assessing all legacy journeys, drip campaigns and triggered sends; prioritising for migration, rebuild or retirement; mapping legacy automation logic to Journey Builder native capabilities; and defining the functional acceptance criteria for each migrated journey.

* Manage scope and functional sign\-off — maintaining the solution scope register, managing scope change requests, producing functional design documents and obtaining formal business sign\-off at each MDLC phase gate before the Technical Architect begins build.
* Serve as Trusted Advisor to the client — building long\-term relationships with client marketing technology leads, digital directors, CDOs and Enterprise Architects; providing candid guidance on MCN platform capabilities, migration trade\-offs and post\-migration marketing strategy.
* Govern functional quality of deliverables — reviewing all functional design documents, process maps, data mapping sheets, journey design artefacts and user acceptance test scripts produced by the track team to ensure they meet factory quality standards and client expectations.
* Validate business process equivalence post\-migration — leading user acceptance testing (UAT) planning, supporting client business users through UAT execution, managing defect triage and confirming that migrated journeys, subscriber segments and send logic deliver the same business outcomes as the legacy platform.
* Lead email deliverability strategy — advising on IP warm\-up planning, domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation management and inbox placement testing strategy post\-migration.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory — building reusable MCN solution design templates, discovery workshop guides, journey migration assessment frameworks, consent architecture blueprints and migration approach documents for the factory accelerator library.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

Able to architect solutions end\-to\-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
* Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to MCN — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect's technical approach.
* Subscriber Data Model \& Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
* Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy SFMC Classic) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to MCN equivalents.
* Journey \& Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and prioritise complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Journey Builder native design patterns.
* Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm\-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post\-migration deliverability strategy.
* Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA's implementation approach.
* Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign\-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.
* Salesforce Platform Awareness: Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Sales/Service Cloud data model, Flows and permission sets — sufficient to design end\-to\-end MCN solutions that integrate with the broader Salesforce org.
* Functional Design Documentation: Expertise in producing executive\-quality solution blueprints, functional design documents, process maps, data mapping specifications, migration approach papers and UAT test scripts.
* Workshop Facilitation \& Client Management: Proven ability to lead large, complex discovery workshops and design sessions with senior client stakeholders — managing scope discussions, capturing requirements and building consensus on migration approach.
* Agile Delivery: Proficiency in Agile delivery practices — user story writing, backlog management, sprint planning and sprint review facilitation — within the Migration Factory's MDLC wave delivery model.

description:
**Job Summary** 

 We are seeking a hands\-on, high\-impact Senior Technical Architect (Platform Backend) to lead the architecture, scaling, and continuous evolution of our core platform infrastructure. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high\-throughput transactional systems and cloud\-native architecture. You will be responsible for driving high\-level and low\-level designs (HLD/LLD), establishing engineering guardrails, optimizing complex data pathways, and collaborating directly with product and engineering leaders to ensure absolute reliability, performance, and low latency at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities:System Design \& Architectural Leadership:
 * Own the end\-to\-end High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) for core platform services, asynchronous processing components, and enterprise ERP/bank integration adapters.
* Facilitate a smooth transition from monolithic legacy boundaries into clean, highly cohesive microservices domains without impacting uptime or data integrity.
* Establish architectural governance, lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and review critical pull requests to safeguard code quality, clean architecture principles, and SOLID design patterns.


 Scalability, Performance \& Reliability:
 * Architect multi\-tenant, cloud\-native frameworks capable of handling high\-concurrency and petabyte\-scale financial transactions with strict SLAs.
* Diagnose and eliminate system bottlenecks across distributed transactions, locking models, memory management, and network payloads.
* Oversee zero\-trust security compliance, fault\-tolerance mechanisms, automated failover policies, and disaster recovery readiness.


 Data \& Integration Architecture:
 * Design robust relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and non\-relational database schemas, complex indexing strategies, data partitioning models, and archival frameworks.
* Scale event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or similar messaging systems to manage reliable real\-time data streaming and asynchronous decoupling.

title: Sr. Staff Architect
description:
**About Gap Inc.**
 Our past is full of iconic moments — but our future is going to spark many more. Our brands — Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy and Athleta — have dressed people from all walks of life and all kinds of families, all over the world, for every occasion for more than 50 years.
   

  

 But we’re more than the clothes that we make. We know that business can and should be a force for good, and it’s why we work hard to make product that makes people feel good, inside and out. It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work. If you're one of the super\-talented who thrive on change, aren't afraid to take risks and love to make a difference, come grow with us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Staff Architect, you are a high\-impact individual contributor responsible for designing robust and scalable solutions within a domain stream. You bring deep technical and functional expertise and partner with cross\-functional teams to define and implement architecture that supports business and technical objectives. Department: Enterprise ArchitectureRole : Senior Staff Enterprise Solution ArchitectEmployment Type : Full\- TimeLocation: Hyderabad, India (HDC)This role is focused on hands\-on solution design, documentation, and delivery — with increasing influence across products, platforms, and governing teams. You bring deep expertise in retail and consumer goods, partnering with cross\-functional business, product, and engineering teams to define and implement architecture that is robust, scalable, and aligned to both business and technical objectives.You serve as a bridge between architecture and engineering leadership, ensuring consistency, quality, and performance of solutions. As AI reshapes how software is designed and delivered, you will play an active role in embedding AI\-driven thinking into architecture practices and championing adoption across your domain.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

**Solution design \& documentation**
* Design and document end\-to\-end solutions for key initiatives within your domain, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and business needs.


**Project architecture leadership**
* Lead architecture for individual projects and features, guiding engineering teams through solution execution and well\-reasoned technical trade\-offs.


**Cross\-functional collaboration**
* Partner with strategy teams, product managers, architects and engineers to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable architecture complaining to EA guidelines. Provide architectural input across multiple simultaneous initiatives.


**Quality, feasibility \& integration alignment**
* Ensure technical feasibility, performance, and integration alignment of solutions with adjacent systems and domains. Participate in defining, enhancing and ensuring design and code reviews to uphold architectural quality.


**Architecture framework \& reusability**
* Contribute to the evolution of architecture frameworks, reusable components, and reference implementations that raise the bar across the engineering organisation.


**Planning, estimation \& technology evaluation**
* Engage in early project planning and estimation through an architecture lens. Stay current with emerging technologies and help evaluate their applicability within your domain.


**AI ADOPTION**
* Identify and drive opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities into enterprise domain solutions to enhance business value and operational efficiency.
* Serve as a strategic advocate for responsible, ethical, and compliant AI adoption across the domain architecture landscape.
* Lead the execution and advancement of enterprise architecture strategies in alignment with the vision and direction established by Principal Architects.


**ENTERPRISE ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATION**
* Hands\-on solution design and delivery within a domain stream. Operationalises enterprise guidance into project\-level architecture.


**Alignment With Principal \& Sr Principal Architects**
 Engage regularly with Principal and Senior Principal Architects to ensure domain\-level solutions are grounded in enterprise architecture strategy. Consume and operationalise enterprise standards, patterns, and guardrails into project\-level designs, and surface domain\-specific insights that inform broader strategic decisions.
   

  

**Cross\-domain Architecture Reviews**
 Participate in architecture review boards and cross\-domain design forums facilitated by Principal Architects. Represent your domain's perspective, highlight integration touch\-points, and collaborate on solutions that span multiple domain streams.
   

  

**Feedback Loop \& Pattern Sharing**
 Maintain a continuous feedback loop with the EA team — sharing reusable patterns, lessons learned, and implementation experiences from domain delivery that can be elevated into enterprise\-wide frameworks and reference architectures.
   

  

**Strategic Roadmap Contribution**
 Contribute domain\-level input to enterprise technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives led by Senior Principal Architects. Help bridge the gap between long\-term architectural vision and near\-term delivery realities within your domain.
   

  

**SaaS Vendor Product Evaluations**
 Collaborate with Principal Architects and product stakeholders to ensure recommended SaaS choices are grounded in both domain delivery needs and long\-term enterprise architecture direction.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Seasoned technologist with strong architectural thinking and a solid background in hands\-on software or platform engineering.
* Deep understanding of at least one architectural Product to Market domain stream, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to cross\-domain conversations.
* Able to manage and prioritise multiple concurrent initiatives, providing architectural support from planning through to delivery.
* Experienced engaging with senior architecture leadership — comfortable consuming enterprise strategy from Principal and Senior Principal Architects and translating it into grounded, deliverable domain solutions.
* Skilled at producing technical documentation and architecture artifacts that clearly communicate design intent to both Strategy, Business, Engineering and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative and delivery\-oriented, with a track record of working closely with cross\-functional product and engineering teams.
* Strong attention to detail with a passion for quality, performance, and reusability; capable of independently solving architectural challenges and escalating when cross\-functional coordination is needed.
* SaaS Vendor Evaluations \- Translate SaaS market evaluations into well\-reasoned architectural recommendations with clear trade\-off analysis : Cost \& TCO over time, Scalability \& performance, Integration complexity, Vendor maturity \& stability, Enterprise standards alignment, PoC / reference validation
* Eager to learn, grow, and actively contribute in defining and adopting enterprise architectural practices and patterns across the organisation.
* Comfortable navigating the nuances of responsible AI adoption — including data privacy, model governance, and balancing innovation with risk.
* A trusted voice within the EA community — able to represent domain interests in broader architecture forums while remaining open to enterprise\-wide direction and standards.
* Curious about AI and its practical application in enterprise architecture — whether through predictive analytics, generative AI, ML\-powered features, or AI\-augmented engineering workflows.

* One of the most competitive paid time off plans in the industry
* Comprehensive health coverage for employees, same\-sex partners and their families
* Health and wellness program: free annual health check\-ups, fitness center and Employee Assistance Program
* Comprehensive benefits to support the journey of parenthood
* Retirement planning assistance
* See more of the benefits we offer.


 Gap Inc. is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. We have received numerous awards for our long\-held commitment to equality and will continue to foster a diverse and inclusive environment of belonging. In 2022, we were recognized by Forbes as one of the World's Best Employers and one of the Best Employers for Diversity.

 Countries

 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in Master Data Management with 3\+ years of Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS solution, with at least \+3 years managing teams and delivering successful MDM implementations

 Data governance frameworks
   

  

 Data quality methodologies

 Key Competencies

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. title: Vice President | Senior Engineer API Gateway

description:

 13

+ AWS Glue for integration and catalog\-driven processing
+ AWS Lambda for event\-driven processing

+ Code generation
+ Code refactoring
+ SQL optimization
+ PySpark optimization, etc.

* Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones.
* Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable technical designs, implementation patterns, and delivery plans.
* Comfortable operating in a role that blends hands\-on engineering, technical strategy, architecture influence, delivery enablement, and cross\-team technical mentorship.


**Data Platform and Cloud Engineering Expertise**
* Strong hands\-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows.
* Experience working with Databricks\-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse\-oriented architecture.
* Strong familiarity with AWS cloud\-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Kinesis, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms.

description:
Manages technical support staff who provide technical support for the design and building of technical solutions. Provides leadership in designing, developing and implementing solutions in support of the business, according to standards and policies.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role manages technical support staff who provide technical support for the design and building of technical solutions. Provides leadership in designing, developing and implementing solutions in support of the business, according to standards and policies, while mentoring junior staff and guiding technology decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager of Cloud Platform Engineering to lead a team responsible for designing, supporting, and evolving cloud\-based technology platforms. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, business judgment, and problem\-solving ability.
* The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader who can quickly recognize patterns, diagnose complex issues, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions that balance risk, operational stability, and business outcomes. While hands\-on coding is not a primary responsibility, the successful candidate must possess sufficient technical depth to guide engineering teams, evaluate solutions, and influence architectural decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of cloud engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on cloud platform strategy, architecture, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, security, architecture, and business teams to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.
* Facilitate technical decision\-making by evaluating trade\-offs, identifying risks, and aligning recommendations with organizational objectives.
* Apply strong pattern recognition and analytical thinking to identify root causes, recurring issues, operational trends, and optimization opportunities.

* Drive issue resolution across organizational boundaries and remove obstacles preventing team success.
* Establish operational best practices, governance processes, and performance metrics.
* Support workforce planning, performance management, career development, and succession planning activities.
* Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

Collaborates with key stakeholders to develop and maintain standards for platforms. Implements new technologies for enterprise\-wide infrastructure projects.

* Maintain the security of cloud infrastructure, ensuring compliance with both internal business standards and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Oversee and monitor hybrid cloud environments, ensuring optimal performance, uptime, and resource allocation for the organization.
* Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline the deployment, management, and scaling of cloud\-based resources, improving operational efficiency.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for cloud architectures, designs, and system configurations to guide future development and operational support.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in managing complex enterprise\-wide cloud infrastructure projects and environments.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Strong understanding of cloud security principles, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation.

title: Senior Technical Lead (Product Releases & Engineering)
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
 Company Name: Incepteo
   

  

 Industry: Information Technology \& Services
   

  

 Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level
   

  

 Experience: 5\+ yrs
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
   

  

 Job Type: Full\-time
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 Senior Technical Lead – Product Releases \& Engineering
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.
   

  

 The role sits between the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, Technical Architect and engineering team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that multiple developers, features and code changes come together into stable, well\-coordinated product releases.
   

  

 This is not simply a senior developer role and it is not a purely managerial position. You must remain technically hands\-on while taking ownership of release coordination, engineering discipline and day\-to\-day technical delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Management
   

  

 You will coordinate releases across Development → Test / QA → UAT → Production → Monitoring.
   

  

  

* Coordinate release scope with the Product Owner and Delivery Manager, maintaining visibility of features, fixes and dependencies
* Ensure development, code reviews, integration and testing are completed before release and conduct technical release\-readiness checks
* Coordinate application, API, database and configuration changes; manage release branches, versioning, hotfixes and production fixes
* Coordinate deployments across Dev, Test, UAT and Production, support UAT issue resolution and provide technical Go / No\-Go recommendations
* Ensure rollback or recovery procedures are understood, validate Production releases and coordinate post\-release issue resolution


 The objective is to create a repeatable, controlled and increasingly automated release process rather than relying on individual developers or last\-minute effort.
   

  

 Engineering Team Coordination
   

  

  

* Maintain visibility of development progress and identify dependencies across frontend, backend, database and integrations
* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early
* Coordinate work where features cross multiple components, help resolve difficult technical issues and review progress against sprint and release commitments
* Escalate architectural concerns to the Technical Architect, delivery risks to the Delivery Manager, and work with the Product Owner where requirements need clarification


 The successful candidate should bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
   

  

 Engineering Maturity \& Quality
   

  

 You will help strengthen:
   

  

  

* Pull\-request and code\-review discipline; Git branching, merge management, release branching and versioning
* Definition of Done, release\-readiness criteria, automated build/test/deployment, code coverage and automated testing
* Environment management, logging and monitoring, technical documentation, incident management and root\-cause analysis
* Technical\-debt management and secure development practices


 You will ensure code produced by different developers is properly reviewed, consolidated and integrated before entering shared environments.
   

  

 Hands\-On Technical Capability
   

  

 Although release and team coordination are the main focus, this remains a hands\-on technical leadership role. You should be comfortable working across React / React.js, Python, REST APIs and backend services, MySQL or similar relational databases, Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions / CI/CD, Google Cloud Platform, authentication and authorisation, SaaS integrations, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 Strong, practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and GitHub is vital for this role. You should have hands\-on experience using Google Cloud services to deploy, operate, monitor and troubleshoot production SaaS applications, and be confident managing GitHub repositories, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews, permissions and GitHub Actions\-based CI/CD workflows.
   

  

 You should be capable of reviewing code, challenging implementation decisions and stepping into complex technical or production issues when necessary.
   

  

 Experience with AI applications, LLMs, agents, RAG, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini would be advantageous.
   

  

 Production \& Incident Management
   

  

  

* Assess incident severity and impact, coordinate developers during investigation and identify root causes
* Manage hotfixes and emergency releases, communicate technical status clearly and validate systems following fixes
* Conduct root\-cause reviews and ensure preventative actions are completed


 We are looking for someone who remains calm, methodical and accountable under pressure.
   

  

 Experience We Are Looking For
   

  

 Ideally, you will have 5\+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful technical leadership responsibility in a production SaaS environment, including:
   

  

  

* Coordinating development teams and managing SaaS releases into Production across Dev, Test, UAT and Production environments
* Google Cloud deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting
* GitHub repository, branch, pull\-request and permissions management, including GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation
* Release\-readiness, deployment processes, code consolidation and strong code\-review practices
* Production incident resolution, cross\-functional working with Product Owners, architects and delivery managers, and continuous engineering process improvement


 We are particularly interested in candidates who have personally owned these responsibilities, rather than simply participated within a team where others managed releases and coordination.
   

  

 Leadership Maturity
   

  

  

* Ownership – takes responsibility and drives outcomes
* Judgement – knows when to proceed, challenge or escalate
* Organisation – keeps multiple developers and dependencies coordinated
* Communication – explains technical issues clearly
* Composure – remains effective during releases and incidents
* Constructive leadership – guides developers without micromanaging
* Quality mindset – balances speed with reliability
* Continuous improvement – strengthens processes after every release


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

  

* More predictable and controlled releases with clear ownership and readiness criteria
* Better engineering coordination with earlier visibility of blockers and dependencies
* Stronger GitHub, PR, code\-review, testing and CI/CD discipline and more reliable Google Cloud operations
* Fewer release\-related defects and last\-minute integration issues, with faster Production incident resolution
* Improved engineering maturity and reduced dependency on individual heroics


**In one sentence: Your responsibility is to turn multiple developers, features and code changes into one coordinated engineering team delivering stable, high\-quality SaaS releases consistently for the Stratpilot venture, using strong GitHub practices and reliable Google Cloud delivery and operations.**
**About The Company**
 About Incepteo Labs Incepteo Labs Private Limited is a dynamic and fast\-growing startup venture builder creating innovative technology products and businesses. This role offers the opportunity to work in a high\-energy environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution and where engineer
   

  

 Good\-to\-have skills
   

  

 Release Management

title: Cloud AI Security - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Manager \- Cloud AI Security
   

  

 Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross\-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high\-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.
   

  

 Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
   

  

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud\-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001\.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform\-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service\-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud\-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI\-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red\-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.

* Blue Yonder is a leading AI\-driven Digital Supply Chain and Cognitive Planning Solutions company, enabling global enterprises to transform end\-to\-end supply chain operations through intelligent, autonomous, scalable, and cloud\-native planning platforms.
* Leveraging advanced AI, Machine Learning, Optimization, and Agentic AI, Blue Yonder empowers smarter, faster, and more resilient decision\-making across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Fulfillment, Logistics, and Manufacturing.
* We are seeking highly skilled Solution Architects / Sr. Solution Architects with deep expertise in Supply Chain Planning implementations, strong consulting and solutioning capabilities, and proven customer engagement experience.


**Scope**
* Lead end\-to\-end implementations of Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning solutions (ESP, DSP, IO, OP, S\&OP/IBP, Production Planning, Supply Planning). Architect scalable, high\-performance planning solutions aligned with customer business objectives and industry best practices.
* Drive solution lifecycle from requirements gathering, design, configuration, integration, SIT/UAT, Go\-live, and Hypercare. Provide thought leadership on supply chain transformation initiatives and AI\-enabled planning journeys.
* Mentor consultants and guide implementation teams across functional and solution architecture areas.
* Support integration with ERP, APS, MES, WMS, TMS, Data Lakes, and Cloud platforms.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and validate complex supply planning models (multi\-echelon, constrained planning, deployment, inventory optimization, sourcing prioritization, capacity planning, scenario modeling).
* Handle challenges involving solver behavior, planning trade\-offs, data quality, performance optimization, and scalability.
* Develop solution design documents, functional specifications, data mapping, and testing strategies.
* Communicate business cases to Product Management and Development for future product enhancements.
* Support customer success initiatives, driving adoption of advanced planning capabilities.
* Act as a trusted advisor, enabling faster deployments and improved customer adoption through AI\-enabled methodologies.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain Planning implementations and consulting.
* Proven hands\-on implementation experience in BY ESP, Demand Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Order Promising, and Advanced Supply Chain Planning solutions.
* Strong implementation experience in similar planning platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, OMP, SAP APO / IBP, and Oracle Supply Chain Planning will be considered an added advantage.
* Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex global supply chain transformations across CPG, Hi\-Tech, Process Manufacturing, Automotive, and Industrial Manufacturing industries.
* Strong supply chain domain expertise is mandatory and non\-negotiable.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to independently drive solutioning discussions and architect scalable solutions for complex customer requirements.


**Good To Have**
* Experience in SQL Python
* Experience with ORACLE and SNOWFLAKE databases
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain data models
* Experience with cloud\-native planning architectures
* API and Integration architecture understanding
* BY Platform / Data Cloud / BYDM exposure


**AI / Digital Skills**
* Understanding of AI/ML\-driven planning capabilities in Supply Chain.
* Exposure to ML\-based forecasting and intelligent planning solutions.
* Knowledge or experience in Agentic AI, AI\-driven automation, or GenAI\-based implementation accelerators will be a strong advantage.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

**Job Description**
 About Us
   

  

 Innovapptive is a category\-defining SaaS company building the world’s most advanced AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by Vista Equity Partners, Innovapptive is on a mission to reimagine how industrial work gets done — connecting frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.
   

  

 Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard\-dollar results, such as:
   

  

* Over $40 million in annual EBITDA savings at a single enterprise
* 10× frontline productivity improvements through mobile\-first and AI\-enabled workflows

* Named a Leader in the Frost \& Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar

* Cited by LNS Research for delivering 3–5× greater value than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field\-proven ROI


 Our growth is backed by Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high\-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next\-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting\-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.
   

  

 Today, with over 300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to $100M ARR within the next 3\-4 years by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We are seeking a Solution Architect to serve as the primary technical bridge between Innovapptive applications Connected Worker Platform and complex enterprise environments. In this advisory role, you will perform detailed fit/gap analyses of enterprise landscapes, translate business pain points into architectural strategies, and advise on integration best practices. You will lead technical discussions with enterprise IT teams to ensure our solutions align with their existing digital infrastructure and long\-term goals.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Our Company**
 At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a
 **Principal Engineer** 
 , you will play a key role in designing and delivering highly scalable, next generation Database products within our
 **Database Marketplace** 
 . You will work in a technically rich environment with talented peers, contributing to product strategy, architecture, and execution while influencing the evolution of Teradata’s DB capabilities.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Design, architect, develop, and maintain high quality systems, services, and applications with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineers and product partners to shape architecture and consistently deliver end to end features.
* Storage layer evolution — Work on page management, durability guarantees, and consistency semantics across disaggregated compute\-storage topologies.
* Write path and recovery — Extend the logging and recovery subsystem for multi\-node and branching workload patterns.
* Concurrency and isolation — Build visibility and isolation semantics for non\-linear, multi\-context execution patterns.
* Executor\-storage interface — Own buffer management, prefetch behavior, and cost model correctness when storage is remote.
* Agentic tooling — Use AI coding agents critically on a large C/C\+\+ codebase. Know where they fail.
* Technical leadership — Drive implementation\-level decisions across global engineering teams.


**Who You’ll Work With**
 You will be part of a high\-performing engineering team building core components of Teradata’s AI platform. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, AI/ML specialists, product managers, cloud architects, and partner teams across the company. The role offers opportunities to contribute directly to Teradata’s AI product roadmap and technological direction.
   

  

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
* Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a recognized institution.
* 15\+ years of experience on backend services, distributed systems, or data platform development.
* Strong proficiency in C, C\+\+, Rust for development.
* Internals experience with PostgreSQL or postgres based relational engine — source\-level, not API\-level
* Deep understanding of the WAL write path, checkpointing, and crash recovery mechanics
* Ability to trace and resolve concurrency anomalies through the engine's MVCC implementation
* Clear mental model of where traditional storage assumptions live in the executor and buffer manager
* Practical experience with AI coding assistants on production systems engineering work


**What You’ll Bring**
* Deep expertise in systems or database engineering, with meaningful time spent inside a relational engine at the source level
* Demonstrated contributions to PostgreSQL or an equivalent open\-source engine — patches, extensions, or fork\-level work
* Production experience with storage or replication subsystems under real failure conditions
* Comfort operating across distributed teams with high autonomy and low process overhead
* A track record of technical decisions that held up — and the judgment to know when to revisit them


**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
 We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti\-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
   

  

 Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
